description: The Fulton County Democratic Party Executive Committee is proud to announce our full support for Sara Fuchs in the race for Georgia House District 49.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Sara Fuchs for Georgia
title: Fulton County Democrats endorse Sara Fuchs for House District 49 — Sara Fuchs is the Democratic candidate for Georgia State House District 49, representing parts of Alpharetta, Roswell and Milton, in the November 3, 2026 election.
